_comment: The single source of truth for who else touches customer data (issue 133).
The list used to exist in three places: prose in the privacy policy, a table
in the DPA annex, and reality. Three copies drift, and the one that drifts
is always the published one. site/build.mjs generates the page from this
file and fails the build if a required field is missing, the same way it
Removed entries stay, with status 'removed' and a removedAt date, because
procurement asks what changed and when - a page that can only show the
noticeSentAt is the date customers were told. The DPA promises 30 days'
notice before a new sub-processor starts, so a 'current' entry whose
addedAt is less than 30 days after its noticeSentAt is a broken promise,

subprocessors.name: Amazon Web Services, Inc.
subprocessors.purpose: Hosting, databases, file storage, email and SMS delivery, AI inference, and sign-in
subprocessors.safeguard: Standard contractual clauses in the AWS data processing addendum

subprocessors.name: Stripe, Inc.
subprocessors.purpose: Subscription billing for your MakerBay plan, and card payments from your customers to you
dataCategories: your billing contact and subscription history
for Connect payments: your customer's name, email and payment details, handled by Stripe directly
subprocessors.safeguard: Standard contractual clauses in the Stripe data processing agreement
subprocessors.role: sub-processor for subscription billing; independent controller for Connect payments under its own agreement with you
